newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jusco Co ask-only on outlook of Talbots.
newsitem.headline: Jusco Co ask-only on outlook of Talbots.

text.p: Shares of supermarket operator Jusco Co Ltd were ask-only on Friday morning, depressed by the view that expected weak earnings of its subsidiary Talbots Inc may hurt Jusco's group profits, traders said.
At 0153 GMT, Jusco's share price was ask-only at 3,550 yen, against Thursday's close of 3,750.
Talbots said on Tuesday that it expects a net loss for the second quarter in the range of $0.28 to $0.38 per share. Talbots added that it expects to remain profitable for the full year.

Nomura Securities' analyst Hirokazu Ishii said in a report on Friday that the U.S. retailer's weak earnings were likely to slow growth of Jusco's group profits. Jusco's sales in domestic markets have already slackened due to fierce competition, he said.
